title: Freyalise Seals the Skyshroud Rift
summary: Skyshroud's ancient protector gives her life to heal the displaced forest's fracture.
narrative: The Rathi Overlay had brought Skyshroud into Keld, and a dangerous rift threatened its inhabitants.
Freyalise ultimately sacrificed herself to close the wound and protect the people under her care.

The official Freyalise character profile confirms that she gave her life protecting her people during a catastrophe threatening Dominaria, but it does not identify Skyshroud or the exact rift. That location-specific account remains a separate primary-fiction verification task.
